text:
anya: Quick preflight for v1.5.0-rc2 — aiming to cut branch and tag today. Need: changelog blurb merged, docs signoff, security attestation, l10n pass, QA smoke + canary plan. If everything green I'll cut at ~17:30 UTC. Ping owners below.

sam: Working on changelog PR (<https://git/repo/pull/789|PR #789>). Need a one-line blurb for the telemetry opt-in flag — @product-lead can you drop wording? :eyes:

jen: Docs update is ready, pushed to docs/main. PR -> <https://git/repo/pull/790|PR #790>. Also added the rollout note and rollback steps. Version bump command I used:

```
git checkout -b release/v1.5.0-rc2
git tag -a v1.5.0-rc2 -m "v1.5.0-rc2"
```

mike: QA kicking off smoke on dedicated infra now. Hit a flake in async-kv tests, reassigning to @sam to triage. Log snippet:

```
FAILED tests/test_async_kv.py::test_set_get_timeout
AssertionError: Timed out after 5s
```

alex-qa: Smoke pass on most suites except p95 latency regression for embeddings serving on staging. Numbers: p95 went from 120ms -> 210ms under same load. I'm running a focused replay to confirm. Will report within 20m.

l10n-eric: Localization status: es + fr done for UI strings, waiting on docs strings from @docs-sara for the new flag docs. Staging translations uploaded to staging/locale/2025-07-15.

docs-sara: Sent the new strings in <https://git/repo/pull/791|PR #791> — includes context notes for translators. Also left a TODO for two short examples in the telemetry section.

security-team: Dependency scan ran in CI; no critical or high CVEs. We'll attach the signed attestation file to the release artifacts by EOD. Quick note: we saw an optional dep (metrics-lib) at 2.0.0 — no blocker but flagging for post-release bump.

release-bot: Reminder: cut window in ~2h. Open PRs that need merges before cut: #789 (changelog), #790 (docs), #791 (i18n strings). Pipeline: <https://ci/release/4521|pipeline #4521>.

sam: Changelog snippet suggestion: "Add experimental telemetry opt-in flag; opt-in only, no data shipped by default." I'll land PR after wording confirmed. For the release notes YAML, add under releases.v1.5.0:

```yaml
- title: "Telemetry opt-in flag"
  desc: "Add experimental telemetry opt-in flag for advanced debugging"
  owner: product-lead
```

mike: I'm re-running the async-kv test with increased timeout to rule out CI flakiness, will update. If still failing we should gate the cut on that test.

alex-qa: Confirmed: replays show the p95 spike only on staging-NV nodes, not on dedicated. Suggest canary on 5% traffic for 30m to validate before full rollout.

jen: I'll wire the canary instructions into the ops runbook (rollback steps already there).

product-lead: Blurb approved: "Adds an opt-in telemetry flag to help debug inference pipelines; disabled by default." 

oncall: I'll be on-monitor during cut and first 45m after canary. Add me to the incident channel if anything spikes.

mike: Async-kv flake looks like a CI infra timing issue; tests passed on rerun. Marking as non-blocker but monitoring.

security-team: Attestation will be uploaded to the release artifacts bucket and linked in the release notes once pipeline finishes.

release-bot: Deploy scheduled: 2025-07-15T17:30:00Z (pipeline #4521). Canary: 5% for 30m -> automated ramp to 100% if no regressions.

anya: Great — thanks all. Plan: merge #789/#790/#791 ASAP, I will cut release/v1.5.0-rc2 at 17:30 UTC, tag, and kick the pipeline. If anything blocks, call it out here in next 20m. I'll post final status in this thread. :shipit:

jen: +1 on merge order: docs -> changelog -> i18n. I'll coordinate the docs PR merge at T-15m.

release-bot: Final reminder: branch protection will require 2 approvals on release branch. Make sure reviews are in.

anya: Copying in @product-lead and @oncall for awareness. If all merges land cleanly I'll update with the cut confirmation.
